convention.arithmetic: Q,A,b,x over GF(2); l^T x modulo 4
convention.quadratic: x^T Q x = sum_{u<=v} Q[u][v] x[u] x[v] modulo 2
convention.bit_order: blocks are contiguous in partition order; bit 0 is the first bit of the first block
convention.coefficient_syntax: SymPy expression syntax using I, sqrt, exp, pi, and target symbols

construction.method: Stabilizer contraction of T9 with even T-cat6
construction.contracted_qubits: Most significant qubit of each input
construction.identity: (-I)**a * omega**(2*a) = 1; cat parity fixes a to the remaining cat weight parity
